translationRepairs: When a eunuch attendant of the grand coordinator broke the law, Jian arrested and tried him; the man framed him, and he was thrown into the Embroidered Uniform Guard prison.
When a eunuch serving as supreme commander broke the law, Jian arrested and tried him; the man framed him, and he was thrown into the Embroidered Uniform Guard prison.

總督太監 is a eunuch who was himself the supreme commander, not "a eunuch attendant of the grand coordinator"; 卒 here is a soldier/attendant only in another reading, but the subject is the eunuch commander.

Meanwhile the eunuch Gu Dayong and the nobility-holder Mao Rui led troops stationed at Linqing; the bandits then plotted that on the first day of the twelfth month, when the Emperor would inspect the sacrificial victim south of the suburban altar, they would seize the chance to strike at the imperial procession, and one day earlier they hastened toward Bazhou.

Meanwhile the eunuch Gu Dayong and Mao Rui, Earl of Fuqiang, led troops stationed at Linqing; the bandits then plotted that on the first day of the twelfth month, when the Emperor would inspect the sacrificial victims at the southern suburban altar, they would seize the chance to strike at the imperial procession, and one day earlier they hastened toward Bazhou.
伏羌伯 is the noble title Earl of Fuqiang held by Mao Rui, not a generic "nobility-holder"; 省牲南郊 is inspecting the victims at the southern suburb.
He asked that the people be restored to their former occupations, that oxen and seed be lent them, and that their households be exempted for three years.
Restore the people to their former occupations, lend them oxen and seed, and exempt their households for three years.
This unit continues He Jian's direct quotation in the imperative; "He asked that" wrongly breaks the quotation into reported speech.
That year Xuanfu presented the surrendered northerner Tuotuotai and his party at court, and the Emperor enrolled them as warriors of the Imperial Stud Office.
In the eighth year, Xuanfu presented the surrendered northerner Tuotuotai and his party at court, and they were ordered to be enrolled as warriors of the Imperial Stud Office.
八年 is Zhengde 8, not "that year".
Liu Liu was styled Chong and his younger brother Qi was styled Chen; they were men of Wenan, both fierce and skilled at mounted archery.
Liu Liu's personal name was Chong, and his younger brother Qi's personal name was Chen; they were men of Wenan, both fierce and skilled at mounted archery.
名 gives personal names, not styles; 劉六 and 七 are their sobriquets "Sixth" and "Seventh".
Can Vice Minister Ma truly act on his own?"
Can Censor-in-Chief Ma truly act on his own?"
都堂 is the censor-in-chief (Ma Zhongxi held 右都御史), not a vice minister.
Only at Gucheng did they admonish one another not to harm Vice Minister Ma household.
Only at Gucheng did they admonish one another not to harm the household of Censor-in-Chief Ma.
都堂 is the censor-in-chief; the English also lacked a possessive.
Grand Coordinator Wang Su strongly argued Jing's crime, and Wan was spared.
Grand Coordinator Wang Shu strongly argued Jing's crime, and Wan was spared.
王恕 is read Wang Shu (as in the next unit), not Wang Su.
Prince Ning Chen Hao held him in high regard, frequently invited him to intimate feasts, and gave him a gold libation cup.
Zhu Chenhao, Prince of Ning, held him in high regard, frequently invited him to intimate feasts, and gave him a gold libation vessel.
宸濠 is the given name of Zhu Chenhao, Prince of Ning, not a separate person "Chen Hao".
The throne appointed Dayong grand coordinator, the Earl of Fuxiang Mao Rui as commander-in-chief, and Zhang Zhong over the firearm corps, sending five thousand capital troops to fight alongside Wan.

The throne appointed Dayong supreme commander of military affairs, the Earl of Fuqiang Mao Rui as regional commander, and Zhang Zhong as supervisor of the Divine Firearms, leading five thousand capital troops to join Wan against the bandits.
伏羌伯 is the Earl of Fuqiang; 總督軍務 is supreme commander of military affairs, not grand coordinator.
A rebel named Chen Han joined Ning Long in proclaiming Hui Grand Marshal for the Suppression Campaign Mandated by Heaven, with Zhao Zan as his lieutenant.
A man named Chen Han plotted with Ning Long to proclaim Hui Grand Marshal for the Suppression Campaign Mandated by Heaven, with Zhao Sui as his deputy.
鐩 is read sui; 有陳翰者 introduces a man named Chen Han, and 謀 means plotted.
The court recalled the pair and assigned Censor-in-chief Peng Ze and the Earl of Xianning, Qiu Yue, to the Henan rebels, leaving the capital districts and Shandong to Wan.
The court resolved to recall the pair and separately assigned Censor-in-Chief Peng Ze and Qiu Yue, Earl of Xianning, to the Henan bandits, leaving the capital districts and Shandong to Wan.
廷議 is a court deliberation; the appositive for Qiu Yue was ambiguous.
Wan encamped at Pingdu, sent Xi Yong, Bai Yu, and guerrilla commander Wen Gong forward on three columns, and set Deputy Commanders Zhang Jun, Li Gang, Xu Tai, and Liu Hui to cut off their escape.

Wan encamped at Pingdu, sent Xi Yong, Bai Yu, and guerrilla commander Wen Gong forward on three columns, and ordered Deputy Commanders Zhang Jun and Li Hong, together with Xu Tai and Liu Hui, to divide their forces and cut off the escape.
李鋐 is read Li Hong, not Li Gang; 及泰、暉 adds Xu Tai and Liu Hui distinct from the deputy commanders.
By then Prince Ning Chen Hao was already harboring treasonous intent.
By then Zhu Chenhao, Prince of Ning, was already harboring treasonous intent.
宸濠 is Zhu Chenhao, Prince of Ning; "Chen Hao" wrongly suggests a separate person (and collides with the official Chen Hao 陳鎬 of this chapter).

Chen Hao then carted tens of thousands in gold and silk to the house of the entertainer Zang Xian, whom he favored, distributing gifts among the men who held sway at court and putting Qian Ning forward as his patron within the palace.

Chenhao then carted tens of thousands in gold and silk to the house of the Music Office entertainer Zang Xian, whom he favored, distributing gifts among the men who held sway at court and making Qian Ning his patron within the palace.
宸濠 is Zhu Chenhao, not "Chen Hao"; 教坊 is the Music Office.
When Chen Hao rose in rebellion he was seized at once.
When Chenhao rose in rebellion he was seized at once.
宸濠 is Zhu Chenhao, not "Chen Hao".
Zhong reported: "Across from Mengdu lay a channel that could reach the mouth of the Baieta River.
Zhong reported: "Across from Mengdu lies a channel that could reach the mouth of the Baita River.
白塔河 is the Baita River; "Baieta" is a corruption.

Meanwhile the Baoning rebel Lan Tingrui called himself King Shun of Heaven, Yan Benyu took the title "King Who Scrapes the Earth," and his lieutenant Liao Hui "King Who Sweeps the Earth"; their forces passed one hundred thousand, with forty-eight chiefs, and ravaged Shaanxi and Huguang.

Meanwhile the Baoning rebel Lan Tingrui called himself King Shun of Heaven, Yan Benshu took the title "King Who Scrapes the Earth," and his lieutenant Liao Hui "King Who Sweeps the Earth"; their forces passed one hundred thousand, with forty-eight chiefs, and ravaged Shaanxi and Huguang.
鄢本恕 is read Yan Benshu (恕 shu), not Benyu.
Tingrui and Hui aimed to seize Baoning while Benyu planned on Hanzhong, Yunyang, and a march east through Jing and Xiang.
Tingrui and Hui aimed to seize Baoning while Benshu planned on Hanzhong, Yunyang, and a march east through Jing and Xiang.
Benyu came in to parley and terms seemed set, until soldiers killed some rebel foragers; the rebels panicked, murdered Xian, and returned to plunder.
Benshu came in to parley and terms seemed set, until soldiers killed some rebel foragers; the rebels panicked, murdered Xian, and returned to plunder.
Grand Coordinator Lin Jun was still debating how to block the Tong River when Hui was already upon them, took the city, slew Vice Commissioner Huang Zan, and drove Qian Zhaofeng and others to flight.

Grand Coordinator Lin Jun was still debating how to hold Tongjiang when Hui was already upon them, took the city, slew Assistant Administration Commissioner Huang Zan, and drove Assistant Surveillance Commissioner Qian Zhaofeng and others to flight.
通江 is Tongjiang county, which the rebels took; 參議 and 僉事 are distinct offices.
When Zhengde began, Supervising Secretary Zhou Xuan and others impeached negligent ministers, Jin included.
When Zhengde began, Supervising Secretary Zhou Xi and others impeached negligent ministers, Jin included.
周璽 is read Zhou Xi, not Zhou Xuan.

The Yao of Maping and Luorong were rampant; Jin and Commander Mao Rui marched one hundred thirty thousand men against them, killed or captured over seven thousand, and Jin was promoted to Left Censor-in-chief.

The Zhuang of Maping and Luorong were rampant; Jin and Regional Commander Mao Rui marched one hundred thirty thousand men against them, killed or captured over seven thousand, and Jin was promoted to Left Censor-in-chief.
僮 here is the Zhuang people, not the Yao.
Cen Meng's men demanded a thousand taels of gold; Jin refused, and they let the rebels slip away.
Cen Meng's men demanded a thousand taels of gold as a reward; Jin begrudged it, and they let the rebels slip away.
靳 means to begrudge; the reward demand should be made explicit.
Jian posted Zhi, Hu Shining, and Wu Tingju at choke points to cut retreat while he and Regional Commander Li Gang stole forward through rain by night.
Jian posted Zhi, Hu Shining, and Wu Tingju at choke points to cut off retreat while he and Regional Commander Li Hong stole forward through rain by night.
李鋐 is read Li Hong, not Li Gang.
Prince Ning Chen Hao prompted Zhang Aoshan to impeach Jian; in the eleventh year he was recalled and retired.
Zhu Chenhao, Prince of Ning, prompted Censor Zhang Aoshan to impeach Jian; in the eleventh year he was recalled and asked to retire.
宸濠 is Zhu Chenhao, Prince of Ning, not "Chen Hao"; 御史 identifies Zhang Aoshan as a censor.
For merit his southern salary rose one rank; then his mother died and he went into mourning.
For merit Nan's salary was raised one grade; then his mother died and he went home in mourning.
增南俸一秩 means Zhou Nan's (南) salary was raised; it is not a "southern salary".
In the ninth year's spring he became Right Censor-in-chief and grand coordinator of the two Guang.
In the ninth year's spring he became Right Censor-in-chief and supreme commander of military affairs of the two Guang.
總督兩廣軍務 is supreme commander, not grand coordinator.
Vice Commissioners Yang Zhang and Ling Xiang also attacked Long and Sizai and took them.
Vice Commissioner Yang Zhang and Assistant Commissioner Ling Xiang also attacked Long and Sizai and took them.
僉事 is assistant commissioner, distinct from 副使.
Guerrilla Yan Xun ran Mazi down and killed him at Jianzhou; survivors fled and raised Yu Sibo as chief.
Mobile Corps Commander Yan Xun ran Mazi down and killed him at Jianzhou; survivors fled and raised Yu Sifeng as chief.
遊擊 is a mobile corps commander; 喻思俸 reads Yu Sifeng.
He once sent Zhang Jie and Wu Li against Songpan's northern and southern Tibetans, lost over three thousand men, and hid the defeat from court.

He once sent Vice Regional Commander Zhang Jie and Vice Commissioner Wu Li against the Tibetans of the northern and southern routes of Songpan; they failed, lost over three thousand men, and he hid it from the court.
副總兵 is vice regional commander and 副使 a surveillance vice commissioner; the defeat was concealed.
